text.description_html:
Rubber Tips for Deltana BDS Baseboard Door Bumpers

This is a replacement rubber tip for the Deltana Baseboard Door Bumpers. Available in your choice of dark gray or white rubber.

For use with:
BDS350 3-1/2" Contemporary Door Stops
BDS450 4-1/2" Contemporary Door Stops
BDS550 5-1/2" Long Contemporary Door Stops
BDS650 6-1/2" Long Contemporary Door Stops

Specifications: for Deltana BDS450-REPL-TIP Rubber Tip Replacement

  • Diameter: 5/8"
  • Optional White or Dark Gray Rubber

Warning: These work for BDS series Baseboard Door Stops manufactured by Deltana. If you are not sure if your door stop was manufactured by Deltana do NOT order these as they may not work properly.

*Sold individually - NO RETURNS
